observations.B01: The S signs are elevated undotted prime strokes. Fraction denominators read 2, 4, 6, 24, 12.
observations.B02: The letter inside the first right-hand bracket has a doubled left stem and three horizontal bars: read E, without substituting A. The two final connecting signs are pluses.
observations.B03: The whole compressed cursive phrase is tentative. The third group has a very tall looped descender; the next group has a large low loop and two ascenders. Alternatives are retained because the connected low strokes do not securely distinguish the words.
observations.B04: Read the short middle group literally as nb; no expanded nombre is supplied.
observations.B05: Isolated p has a long descending stem and a small right-hand bowl.
observations.B06: The exclamation has a separated low dot and accompanies the p below i. A clipped trace from the adjoining line at the lower edge is excluded.
observations.B07: The three exclamations have visible separated dots. Incomplete preceding marks at the far left and a clipped trace at the top are excluded.
observations.B08: A tall looped D with a trailing e is followed by two horizontal strokes; the latter are retained as an equals sign rather than expanded.
observations.B09: Both signs before the two final zeta terms are horizontal minus strokes.
observations.B10: The first S has a separate elevated prime and low 1; final signs are both minuses.
observations.B11: The sign before the second zeta in the first parenthesis is a horizontal minus, retained as written. The small crossed form after 1/4 resembles a 4 but is uncertain. The brace lies above the parenthesis and carries 5/12.
observations.B12: A canceled sign after 7/12 has merged upper strokes and an uncertain descending stroke. The following coefficient is overwritten; the surviving numerator stem and two denominator loops suggest 1/8 but remain marked uncertain.
observations.B13: The coefficient before zeta_2 has an uncanceled looped 8 denominator. A large comma precedes donc.
observations.B14: The left label reads 80. One brace encloses two equations; the second initial M carries a separate angular hat. All visible fraction signs are retained.
observations.B15: Faint marginal numeral reads 64, with a closed lower loop in 6 and an angular foot on 4.
